items.title: Legacy migration consistency for completed slices and structured decisions
items.context: Legacy migration could produce completed slices with pending tasks and lose structured decision semantics through title-only extraction.

items.title: Canonical requirement and decision read tools
items.context: Added canonical requirement and decision list/get tools and addressed adversarial review findings. The original and follow-up PRs were closed without merge; related behavior later appeared in the v1.15 line and generated three follow-up correctness issues.
items.validation: PR #1613 and PR #1682 are closed without merge. Follow-up issues #1727-#1729 remain tracked separately.
items.nextAction: Use the active canonical-read follow-up PRs as the current authority.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5 routing catalog and Copilot startup fallback
items.context: Registered claude-sonnet-5 in routing capability, cost, and profile tables and added graceful Copilot fallback when the preferred model is temporarily unavailable.
items.nextAction: Guard against duplicate registry rows and invalid provider aliases.

items.title: Package-manager-aware verification commands and bootstrap recovery
items.context: Centralizes npm, pnpm, yarn, and bun command construction. Follow-up commit 8b986a9b restores stale shim backups after interrupted bootstrap runs and writes new backups atomically.
items.validation: PR #1706 remains open. Bootstrap recovery regression tests and the real pi-coding-agent bootstrap build passed locally.
items.nextAction: Review current CI and maintainer feedback; split bootstrap recovery if maintainers require narrower scope.

items.title: Isolate canonical reads from the global workflow database handle
items.context: Routes canonical native and MCP reads through isolated per-project adapters to prevent implicit database creation and global handle mutation.
items.validation: PR #1731 remains open with native and MCP regression coverage described in the PR.
items.nextAction: Resolve checks and maintainer review without combining the SQL predicate or error parity concerns.

items.title: Apply canonical list predicates before SQL limit
items.context: Moves requirement class filtering and decision tombstone exclusion into SQL before LIMIT to prevent under-returning and deleted decision leakage.
items.nextAction: Resolve checks and maintainer review independently of database isolation.

items.title: Canonical read error parity between native and MCP surfaces
items.context: Centralizes db_unavailable, not_found, and query_error semantics and replaces simulated tests with behavioral native-versus-MCP fixtures.
items.nextAction: Resolve checks and maintainer review while preserving the shared error contract.
